preregistration_version_note: Created BEFORE any Phase B selector result existed. Any parameter change AFTER seeing results requires EXPERIMENT_VERSION_BUMP and a full rerun.
evaluation_gold: never read by fair selectors; oracle lanes isolated as B3_ORACLE_LANES (UPPER_BOUND_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY)

B0_POPULARITY_TOP_K.selection: top-K by voteupCount desc, tie-break source_id asc

B1_DENSE_SEMANTIC_TOP_K.selection: top-K by dense cosine(queryText, content) desc, tie-break source_id asc
B1_DENSE_SEMANTIC_TOP_K.embedding: Xenova/bge-small-zh-v1.5 (fp32 ONNX, 512-dim, mean pooling, L2-normalized) via @xenova/transformers; local pinned files; sha256 recorded in embedding identity artifact

B2_QUESTION_STRATIFIED_SIMPLE.selection: 1) floor_q = 1 for every question with >=1 candidate (hard per-question representation; derived ONLY from candidate/source-group structure); 2) global dense-relevance walk preferring floor-unfulfilled questions; 3) simple novelty gate: skip candidate if dense cosine to ANY already-selected source > 0.90
B2_QUESTION_STRATIFIED_SIMPLE.floor_rule: floor_q = 1 per non-empty question; frozen BEFORE run; no per-q popularity quota, no optimizer
B2_QUESTION_STRATIFIED_SIMPLE.anchor: dense cosine to queryText (semantic); popularity NOT used inside groups

B3_DENSE_MMR_MULTI_LANE.selection: MMR with lambda=0.5 over dense embeddings + current fair mechanical lanes (mainstream / evidence_PRESENCE / fresh-window / long-tail proxy; expert+contradictory EMPTY because no independent production-plausible signal), lane quotas from equal lane weights, fill-remaining from full pool
B3_DENSE_MMR_MULTI_LANE.lane_mechanic: same as pilot B2_MMR_NGRAM_PROXY (only embedding backend changes to real dense)

B3_ORACLE_LANES.selection: MMR(lambda=0.5) + gold lanes (expert/contradiction from evaluation gold)
B3_ORACLE_LANES.note: UPPER_BOUND_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; EXCLUDED from winner comparison per task §B3

budgets.rule: per-case K frozen from case.json (pilot cases unchanged); new case-hpylori-treatment: K_SMALL=10, K_MEDIUM=15, K_LARGE=24 (pool 216; K_MEDIUM << pool size)

dense_model.input_normalization: harness normalizeText (stripHtml+lowercase+token filter) then model tokenizer; mean pooling; L2 normalize

corpus_versions.case-hpylori-treatment: gate-01 corpus: 5 questions captured 2026-08-28T04:25Z (216 sources; verify-output valid=true; captured pool is the frozen pool)

gold_versions.pilot_8_cases: g2-chatgpt-adjudicated (unchanged, byte-identical to pilot D2 pack)
gold_versions.case-hpylori-treatment: g2-gate01-provisional-hpylori (PROVISIONAL, proposed by execution agent from full content reading BEFORE any selector result; frozen 2026-08-28T05:00Z)
gold_versions.second_adjudication: DECISION_SENSITIVE_SECOND_ADJUDICATION_PACKET (blinded; ~30-50 labels) for ChatGPT; GOLD_DECISION_SENSITIVITY=HIGH if disagreements change winner

metric_version: D2.1 corrected evaluator (order-invariant question provenance scope model; per-question credit semantics; CASE units excluded from per-question denominators)

pre_registered_decision_rule.OUTCOME_A_PROCEED_WITH_SIMPLIFICATION: B2_QUESTION_STRATIFIED_SIMPLE ~= or > B3_DENSE_MMR_MULTI_LANE on primary coverage metrics AND cost lower AND complexity lower AND stability >= across real cases
pre_registered_decision_rule.OUTCOME_B_PROCEED_CURRENT_RCE_DIRECTION: B3_DENSE_MMR_MULTI_LANE stably delivers important coverage improvements simple selectors cannot across multiple real cases
pre_registered_decision_rule.OUTCOME_C_MORE_SOPHISTICATED_SELECTOR_RE: none of B0/B1/B2/B3 solves question/claim/aspect coverage
pre_registered_decision_rule.OUTCOME_D_RETHINK_RCE_METRIC_MODEL: benchmark metrics do not stably correspond to human research value after evaluator fix + real dense + cross-domain

failure_discipline: INVALID and rebuild if: strategy reads evaluation gold; gold changes after strategy run; dataset changes after preregistration; dense silently falls back to ngram; question provenance depends on source ordering; new case selected after seeing strategy outcome
